message: The other night, we had a surprise blackout, and my family was scrambling to find flashlights. I had just stocked up on some handy power banks and a couple of lanterns, and I couldn’t help but feel a little smug when everyone else was fumbling around in the dark. It’s funny how those ‘just in case’ moments really pay off! Now, I think I’ll make it a habit to keep our emergency supplies organized and easily accessible. You never know when you might need them!
